title: addon thunder (platform keys; thunderid.* is the upstream chart's)

bootstrapSecret.description: ExternalSecret thunder-bootstrap (PreSync hook): admin password and OAuth client secrets for the setup Job.

store.description: ClusterSecretStore the bootstrap Secret is read from.

remoteKey.description: Store key holding the admin/user passwords and the Backstage/MCP client secrets.

aiAgentClients.description: AI agent OAuth clients to bootstrap (scripts 53 rca, 60 finops); unlisted agents get no client.

aiRemoteKey.description: Store key with the AI agents' OAuth client secrets (shared with addon openchoreo-observability-plane).

observabilityRemoteKey.description: Store key with observer-client-secret (shared with the observability plane).

promotionGate.description: Promotion gate OAuth client (script 70): same store key as the gate's per-run ExternalSecret.

remoteKey.description: Store key of the promotion gate client.

openchoreo.description: installation.yaml openchoreo: Thunder's public host is thunder.<controlPlane.host> (templates/validate.yaml).

host.description: OpenChoreo control-plane host (OIDC issuer and Backstage redirect URIs derive from it).

thunderid.description: Upstream ThunderID chart values (not constrained here).
